text:
maya: Quick FYI — FP8 enablement on H100 is producing intermittent latency tails and a small calibration-related quality bump. I dumped a profiler sample set and some eval numbers.

akash: can you paste the perf numbers and the exact TE flags you used?

maya: summary from the run (seq=512, batch=32, warm):
- H100 FP8: median 1.8ms/token, p95 3.2ms, p99 5.6ms, p999 9.2ms
- L40S FP8: median 2.3ms/token, p95 4.1ms, p99 7.8ms, p999 12.1ms
- Observed kernel-retry spikes (~20% of requests) where thread falls back to INT8 slowpath for a few tokens, correlated with KV cache misses.

TE_FLAGS used:```
--te-quant-mode=fp8 
--te-kernel-policy=auto 
--te-int8-fallback=enabled 
--te-kv-cache-size=1.2G 
--microbatch=8
```

sam: interesting. that kernel-retry pattern smells like a path-selection threshold we set for occupancy. if the activation shapes jitter because of KV eviction, we slip into the slow kernel. did you see any eviction churn? :thinking_face:

maya: yeah — KV cache hit-rate drops from ~98% to ~81% during a burst. evictions coincide with slightly longer prefix sequences (client-side). when a cache miss happens we rebuild KV and the transformer engine picks an alternate kernel with extra syncs.

kevin: on the quality side, calibration v2 (per-layer scale stats) gave ~+6% perplexity on our dev prompts for FP8, INT8 kept baseline. so FP8 calibration is improving throughput but hurting quality in some contexts. not catastrophic but noticeable.

akash: proposal: tighten kernel-selection heuristic to prefer INT8-path when KV cache miss probability > 10% or when seq_len < 128, and keep FP8 fastpath for steady-state cache hits. also increase KV prefetch window to reduce misses.

sam: rough heuristic snippet:```
# kernel selector pseudo
if kv_miss_rate > 0.1 or seq_len < 128:
  kernel = "int8_stable"
elif batch_size >= 24 and seq_len >= 256:
  kernel = "fp8_throughput"
else:
  kernel = "fp8_lowlatency"
```
We should also add a short-circuit: if kernel retry count > 2 within 200ms, force fallback to int8 for that session.

maya: sounds good. I'll run an A/B with the selector change + kv prefetch bump (1.2G -> 1.8G) on a small fleet (H100 + L40S) and capture p999 latency and eval metrics. starting now.

perf-bot: Job perf/ab-fp8-kernel-selector-176910 started on 12 hosts (8 H100, 4 L40S). Expected ~2h. Links: https://ci.redwood/p/176910

kevin: please capture a calibration trace (before/after) and include per-layer scale histograms — I want to see which layers are destabilizing. if a handful of attention layers are noisy we can do per-layer mixed precision (FP8 for FFN, INT8 for attention).

maya: noted. will post results and the raw profiler when the run finishes. tagging @akash and @sam for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
